review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked whether its main definitions compete with existing Mathlib concepts. The definitions are contractLeft, contractRight, changeForm, changeFormEquiv, equivExterior, and the two Aux constructions. A grep for contractLeft, contractRight and interiorProduct across Mathlib found only tensor-product contraction in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Contraction.lean, plus uses in Trace, Coevaluation and similar files. That is a different concept: the dual-pairing contraction on tensor products, not left or right interior multiplication by a dual vector on a Clifford algebra. I found no other interior product on exterior or Clifford algebras. contractRight is built from contractLeft and reverse, so it is a named orientation of the same operation, not an independent competing definition. changeForm is built from the file's own foldr, and I found nothing else in Mathlib for it. equivExterior is a new equivalence that uses changeFormEquiv. I found no duplicate concept that would justify consolidation, so I abstain.
